starving.label: No food carried, General Store has only oil
starving.explanation: Original: with no food only the General Store and Home are weighed; the oil fails the starving check, so borg_choose_shop() returns false with no goal. Corrected: the Alchemist is weighed too, Remove Hunger passes the starving check and now counts as food, and the Borg chooses the Alchemist's Scrolls of Remove Hunger (store 4, ware 1).
